extraction_notes: Public datasheet citation: UMW IRLML6402TR, Nov.2024, UTD Semiconductor Co.,Limited, www.umw-ic.com, pp. 1-10. Supplied PDF SHA-256: aa61eab3e1ce91716aa5ea24574f50cfde5ff43d5ff58163c3f9673328051581.

This is a P-channel MOSFET. Datasheet-signed quantities are retained as printed: VDS, VGS, ID, and VSD are negative where specified. Typical-curve axes labelled -VDS, -VGS, -ID, or -ISD are positive magnitudes; each curve test_conditions field states that convention.
Electrical Characteristics are specified at TA = 25 °C unless a different temperature is stated. Threshold is -0.4 V minimum, -0.55 V typical, and -0.95 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 µA.

RDS(on) typical values stored in the schema are 0.05 ohm at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -3.7 A and 0.07 ohm at VGS = -2.5 V, ID = -3.1 A. The corresponding published maximum values are 0.065 ohm and 0.135 ohm, respectively, from p. 3 RDS(on) MAX column.
IDSS is not a schema field: the published maximum is -1 µA at VDS = -20 V, VGS = 0 V, TA = 25 °C, and -25 µA at VDS = -20 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 70 °C (p. 3).
Capacitance table values are typical: Ciss = 633 pF at VDS = -10 V, Coss = 145 pF at VGS = 0 V, and Crss = 110 pF at f = 1 MHz (p. 3). Fig. 5 is a typical VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz curve family.

Gate-charge table values are Qg = 8 nC typical and 12 nC maximum at VDS = -10 V; Qgs = 1.2 nC typical and 1.8 nC maximum at VGS = -5 V; Qgd = 2.8 nC typical and 4.2 nC maximum at ID = -3.7 A. Fig. 6 uses ID = -3.7 A and VDS = -10 V.

Body-diode table values include trr = 29 ns typical and 43 ns maximum at TJ = 25 °C, IF = -1 A, and Qrr = 11 nC typical and 17 nC maximum at dI/dt = -100 A/µs. VSD is -1.2 V maximum at TJ = 25 °C, VGS = 0 V, IS = -1 A, with pulse width ≤ 400 µs and duty cycle ≤ 2%.
The thermal table publishes RthJA = 100 °C/W maximum; no RthJC value is published. Thermal resistance is therefore not represented as a fitted spec in this extraction.

Curve points are digitized from real plotted traces on p. 4 and p. 5. The 25 °C transfer and output curves are used; the datasheet also shows 150 °C transfer/output and diode curves, but those are not 25 °C fitting targets.
